name: Shemaiah (of the family of Adonikam)
title: Returned from Babylon with Ezra
summary: Shemaiah was one of the descendants of Adonikam who came up from Babylon with Ezra, mentioned together with Jeiel.

keyEvents.title: Returns home with Ezra
keyEvents.description: Shemaiah was among the descendants of Adonikam who accompanied Ezra back to Jerusalem.
